THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
THE NEW UNIFORM
059
83
Bow Ruffle
Collared Navy
A navy textured long-sleeve mini
dress with a pale blue Peter Pan
collar and cuffs, a bodice of stacked
ruffles tied with a dark self-tie bow
and a ruffled hem. Dark knee-high
socks, brown chunky loafers and a
brown leather shoulder bag
complete the look against a soft
grey studio backdrop.
